title: Insulating foam-filled tubes and solid rods for live working
clause_1_scope: This standard covers foam-filled tubes and solid rods such as those currently available without excluding possible future developments of tubes protected internally in other ways and tubes and solid rods protected externally.
clause_3_terminology: filled tubes and solid rods for live working

marking_requirements: Each tube or rod shall carry at least the following information:
- name or trade mark of the manufacturer;
The marking shall not affect the performance of the tube or rod. If a removable label is used the
performance shall not be affected by its removal.
